problem.read: We could not load the questionnaire
problem.readBody: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you typed is lost: it is kept with us.
problem.gone: This link no longer opens the questionnaire
problem.goneBody: It was answered, withdrawn or it expired. Ask us for a new link.
problem.changed: The questionnaire changed a moment ago
problem.changedBody: We loaded the new version; your answers are kept where the questions are the same. Check them and send again.
problem.fieldsBody: We moved you to the first one: each field says what to fix.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time
problem.rateLimitedBody: Wait a minute, then press Sign and send again.
problem.server: We could not take your answers just now
problem.serverBody: Nothing was sent. Press Sign and send again in a moment.
problem.networkBody: We do not know whether your answers arrived. Press Sign and send again: if they did arrive, the link says it has been used — then we have them.

draft.restored: We kept your answers from {day} at {time}
draft.restoredBody: You can go on from where you stopped.

later.held: Answer something first: there is nothing to keep yet.
later.saved: Your answers are kept with us
later.savedBody: Open the same link again to go on, until {day}.

intro.title: Why we ask
intro.why: {company} checks its supply chain for forced and child labour, as the EU Forced Labour Regulation (EU) 2024/3015 asks of everyone who sells in the EU from December 2027. Your answers and documents are part of that due diligence.
intro.time: It takes about 20 minutes. Keep your certificates (PDF or photo) and their expiry dates at hand.
intro.later: Your answers are saved with us as you type: close the page and come back from the same link until {day}.
intro.readerNamed: {name} of {company} reads your answers and writes to you if anything is missing.
intro.reader: The purchasing team of {company} reads your answers and writes to you if anything is missing.

step.empty: Nothing to answer in this step.

company.title: 1 · Company
company.lead: Who you are: as you want {company} to hold it.

contacts.title: 2 · Contacts
contacts.lead: Who handles orders, invoices and quality.

sites.title: 3 · Sites and sub-suppliers
sites.lead: Where the work is done, including your sub-suppliers' sites.

certifications.title: 4 · Certifications and tests
certifications.lead: Your documents with their dates: we capture them once and remind you before they expire.

labour.title: 5 · Labour and social
labour.lead: Due-diligence questions. Answer as things are; where an answer needs it, tell us more.

sign.title: 6 · Review and send
sign.lead: Check every answer, then sign the statement and send it to {company}.

nav.keys: Keyboard: ← → move between steps when no field is selected.

send.used: This link has already been used to send the questionnaire.

check.url: Write a web address, for example www.example.com.
check.vat: This VAT number does not look right: check its country prefix and digits.
check.name: Write the person's name.
check.phone: Write a phone number: digits, spaces and + ( ) . -
check.file: Upload the document (PDF, JPEG or PNG).
check.issuedFuture: The day it was issued is today or before.
check.expired: This document has expired: upload the one in force.
check.expiresBefore: It expires after the day it was issued.
check.explain: Tell us more about this answer.
check.sign: Read the code of conduct and sign it.
check.stray: This answer is not part of the questionnaire any more.
check.sameFile: Each document answers one question: upload it again where it belongs.
check.signedRole: Write your role in the company.
check.truthful: Confirm the answers are true to the best of your knowledge.

vat.failed: We could not check it just now: you can go on, we check it later.
vat.otherNameHint: VIES holds this number under another name: check the legal name above.
vat.ERROR: VIES did not answer: you can go on, we check it later.
vat.NOT_CHECKED: Format correct (VIES checks EU numbers outside Italy)
vat.onFile: We hold {vat} for you: change it only if it is wrong.

upload.hint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 20 MB
upload.type: {name} is not a PDF, JPEG or PNG.
upload.closed: We cannot take documents from links right now: send the questionnaire without it, and we will ask for it.

document.expiresHint: Leave it empty if it does not expire.

code.open: Read the code of conduct (opens a new tab)
code.failed: The code of conduct did not open: try again.
code.sign: I have read the code of conduct and we follow it in our work for {company}

sites.noneSub: No sub-supplier yet: add those that work on what you make for us.
sites.name: Name

review.fixFirst_one: {count} answer needs a look before you send
review.fixFirst_other: {count} answers need a look before you send
review.fixFirstBody: Use Change on the step marked To fix.

sign.title: Signed statement
sign.legal: By typing your name you sign this questionnaire for your company and send it to {company}. Your answers are kept with the date and time.
sign.truthful: The answers are true to the best of my knowledge.
sign.name: Name and surname

done.title: Sent — {company} reviews it
done.body: We write to you if anything is missing.

next.review: {company} reads your answers and your documents.
next.questions: If we have questions, we write to you and send a new link to answer them.
next.documents_one: Your document is kept with its expiry date: we remind you before it expires.
next.documents_other: Your {count} documents are kept with their expiry dates: we remind you before they expire.

done.contact: Questions? Reply to the e-mail that brought you the link.
